All rectangles are pixels on a 1080x1920 canvas, origin top-left. Safe-zone numbers are conservative design assumptions from published platform UI guides - see phase-1.5/BUILD-NOTES.md; re-verify against the live apps at Phase 4.

stage.note: Diagram zone, full width above the presenter. Revision #4 (24 Oct 2026, Alvin's direction - accommodate the space for visuals until Carla's headroom): stage expanded DOWN, y470-1030 -> y470-1180. Stage bottom is set by Carla's headroom = presenter zone top (y1205) minus ~25px; if her scale/zone ever changes, the stage bottom follows her head top. Was y470, h560 (bottom y1030).

presenter_zone.note: Carla lower-left at scale 0.3 (0.5 at first build; reduced to 0.4 then 0.3 on 24 Oct 2026 at Alvin's direction - more room for visuals), feet on y=1540 - above the FB bottom block (y>=1560). Feet baseline deliberately UNCHANGED at the safe edge: Alvin explicitly declined moving her down into the bottom block. Zone = union of all 9 poses rendered at scale (widest celebrate 876x1102 asset -> 263x331 on screen; true sprite footprint x122-384, y1209-1540, recomputed with build-presenter.py head-anchor geometry) with the established 24px left frame margin and ~4px breath headroom kept (same convention as the 0.4 zone). Home anchor x=245 unchanged; caption band stays clear to her right.

caption_band.note: Right of the presenter zone, fully inside the FB safe_content_rect. Revision #3 (24 Oct 2026, Alvin's direction - more room for visuals): captions moved DOWN, bottom-anchored - the caption text block's bottom edge sits at y=1500, 40px above the y1540 safe edge; longer captions grow UPWARD from there and must not rise above the band top (y1280). Band = moved text block with padding (measured 4-line sample: glyphs x487-920, y1305-1500; element top y1301). Was x486-934, y1150-1480, top-anchored at y1150 (sample glyphs y1154-1349; moved +151px).
